toolName.description: mcp.call: upstream tool; other kinds: the harness-native tool name

args.description: mcp.call: the tools/call arguments verbatim (harness tool_input), forwarded for the server-side approval fingerprint (policyset revision 7, binding: call). ABSENT means the args were not observed, so the fingerprint covers tool identity only; an empty object is the observed no-argument call. Never used for matching in v1beta1.

interpreter.description: shell.exec: detected interpreter basename (python3, bash, …); absent when the command invokes no known interpreter

raw.description: dialect payload verbatim (audit only, never used for decisions)
